components.lifecycle: View creates button and owns activation/busy/disabled; event handlers are removed with owning surface; registry mounts nothing.
components.states_and_limits: Native type=button default for dynamic controls; semantic text/aria-label; focus-visible; minimum control-size token; disabled is native. Explicit local compact calendar styles remain a qualified exception, not a claim of all targets being 44px.

components.usage: conversation header; attach/expand/send; media close; workspace toolbar
components.lifecycle: Same lifetime as owning surface. Existing icon assets and MessageMenu icon provider retained.
components.states_and_limits: 44px shared minimum for marked icon controls. Media close has white visible-focus outline on dark viewer. No new icon library.

components.owner: mounting view / RichComposer for ordered text
components.usage: login/search; conversation richText; workspace editor; Factory fields
components.lifecycle: Existing composition/input/selection and pending upload handling retained.
components.states_and_limits: Names supplied by existing labels/aria-label. Search library removes outline suppression. Native disabled/readOnly behavior retained. No universal validation engine; aria-invalid styling is conditional only.

components.owner: app.js filter and conversation owner; ChatLibrary instance for library tabs
components.lifecycle: Listeners belong to current view. Helper adds no global listeners. Existing native tab selection action is reused.
components.states_and_limits: Filters expose aria-pressed; conversation uses role=tab/aria-selected/roving tabindex and controller leave guard. Library already has arrow/Home/End behavior and is preserved.

components.lifecycle: showModal initializes focus on close; native close/Escape; native connected opener focus return; existing close handler releases media.
components.states_and_limits: Labelled by dialogTitle; viewport bounds from AppShell; sticky header and native scrolling. Qualification covers outbox plus synthetic long title/content geometry, not every domain form.

components.lifecycle: Existing showModal/history/viewport callbacks; user close/backdrop/cancel/history call requestDismissTask; internal successful-save/context cleanup paths remain separate.
components.states_and_limits: Busy blocks close. Dirty/recording/pending user dismissal requires existing browser confirm; denied close preserves editor. Approved discard remains explicit. Existing full route leave guard unchanged.

components.lifecycle: Expanded toggles existing draft flag and inert regions without remounting text/files. Scoped keydown on composer, shared stateless focus boundary, Escape collapses, expand receives focus.
components.states_and_limits: Same ordered blocks/IDs/original Blobs. Menu handler and composition protection retained. No MessageDoc v2, backend or agent invocation implementation.

components.lifecycle: Existing instance, viewport and document key handler removed on destroy. Expanded state uses the same DOM node in native manual-popover top layer with labelled dialog semantics, opaque surface and focus initialization/trap/return; no persistent repair observer.
components.states_and_limits: Expand/collapse retains live editor; dirty sheet guard is in Canvas owner. Task text, project/task fullscreen ownership and geometry tested; existing 1C adds broader Canvas persistence/identity evidence.

components.lifecycle: Existing single active viewer/epoch/release remains; explicit close and Escape use existing close; restore only connected non-hidden/non-inert opener; destroy releases node.
components.states_and_limits: New accessible close supplements existing gestures. Probe mounts actual module/native dialog with synthetic Blob resolver; not a production storage integration proof.

components.lifecycle: Existing initial close focus, Escape/nativecancel, abort/generation cleanup, native modal and explicit focus return retained.
components.states_and_limits: Viewport/safe-area tokens; search keyboard focus visible. Native search Escape can first clear a nonempty query; close-control Escape/close returns focus. No new global search implementation.

compact_controls_exception: Existing Canvas calendar cells keep their compact local geometry; all-control 44px targets and WCAG compliance are not claimed. Critical header/composer/close controls are measured in the browser.
